tagline: Leading diversified media company producing and distributing local and national news, sports and entertainment content across television and digital platforms
hero_kpi_rationale: Primary source of revenue from retransmission and MVPD carriage, representing approximately 59% of net revenue and benefiting from renewed contracts covering over 60% of the subscriber base

kpis.name: Distribution Revenue
kpis.explanation: Fees received for the retransmission of stations signals and carriage of networks by cable, satellite, and other MVPDs
kpis.description: Distribution revenue from retransmission and carriage agreements in millions USD
kpis.signal: Stable with renewed distribution agreements covering 60%+ of subscriber base

kpis.name: Advertising Revenue
kpis.explanation: Revenue from local and national advertising across stations, networks, websites, apps and digital platforms
kpis.description: Advertising revenue from all platforms in millions USD
kpis.signal: Decline driven by economic headwinds and reduced national advertising spend

kpis.name: Total Net Revenue
kpis.explanation: Combined revenue from distribution, advertising and other sources
kpis.description: Total net revenue in millions USD
kpis.signal: Overall revenue decline reflecting weakness in advertising offset partially by stable distribution

kpis.name: Operating Income
kpis.description: Income from operations in millions USD
kpis.signal: Significant decline driven by lower revenues and increased operational costs

kpis.name: Net Income
kpis.explanation: Net profit attributable to shareholders after all expenses and taxes
kpis.description: Net income attributable to Nexstar Media Group in millions USD
kpis.signal: Sharp decline due to impairment of equity method investment and lower operating income

kpis.name: TEGNA Acquisition
kpis.explanation: Definitive merger agreement to acquire TEGNA Inc. for strategic expansion
kpis.description: Acquisition of TEGNA Inc. valued at $6.2 billion cash, including 64 TV stations and 2 radio stations, anticipated to close in H2 2026
kpis.signal: Transformative transaction expected to increase operational diversity, scale and geographic footprint across 51 additional markets

kpis.name: Capital Returned to Shareholders
kpis.explanation: Share repurchases and dividends returned to shareholders during 2025
kpis.description: Approximately $351 million returned to shareholders through stock repurchases and dividends
kpis.signal: Consistent shareholder returns through repurchases and dividends management

ai_positioning.summary: No mention of AI or artificial intelligence initiatives in the 10-K filing
